mission_06: Well done! You have mastered interpolation techniques for time series data, going beyond simple forward and backward fill. Linear interpolation provides a straightforward baseline, polynomial interpolation captures curved trends, and spline interpolation offers smooth, flexible fitting that works well for complex patterns. You learned to quantitatively compare methods using MSE, enabling data-driven selection of the best interpolation approach. These methods are essential for sensor data, financial time series, environmental monitoring, and any domain where measurements may be temporarily unavailable but the underlying process is continuous. The pandas interpolate function makes it trivial to experiment with different methods and orders, allowing you to find the optimal approach for each specific dataset.
